rows.notes: Corrupt Seeds are seeds used to plant Corrupt grass on Dirt Blocks , which will then spread The Corruption in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for 5 SC each during a Blood Moon in a world with Corruption. In a world with Crimson , Corrupt Seeds can be purchased from the Dryad if she is spoken to in a Hardmode Graveyard .
Dynamite can be found in Chests or purchased from the Demolitionist for 20 SC each.

The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station . It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.
The Bell is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Wizard for 1 GC . It is used to the craft the Fairy Bell , a light pet -summoning item.
It can be purchased from the Steampunker for 2 PC .

The Actuator is a mechanism item purchased from the Mechanic for 10 SC each, or harvested from sand traps , lava traps , boulder traps , or Dead Man's Chest traps. It has to be placed on a tile and connected with wiring to function. When activated, the tile it is on toggles between active and inactive state, effectively allowing any block to be toggled like Active or Inactive Stone Blocks . Like Wire, Actuators are normally invisible and only become visible when a mechanism item is held.

The Beach Ball is a novelty item that can be purchased from the Party Girl for 20 CC . Using it creates an interactive beach ball for players to bounce around. After 2 seconds of sitting still or coming to a full stop and then being tapped, it reverts to its item form which can be picked up and reused.

The Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture / weapon , purchased from the Pirate for 25 GC . Once placed, it can be fired by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed). The Cannon fires an arcing Cannonball that explodes upon contact with a block or after piercing three enemies . The explosion does not destroy blocks.
The Cannonball is a type of decorative block sold by the Pirate . Cannonballs can be purchased from the Pirate for 2 SC each.

The Blowgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 5 GC . It is an indirect upgrade to the Blowpipe . When used, it fires Seeds and darts as ammunition . While a Blowgun is in a player's inventory, there is a chance that any vegetation growing on normal grass , in Clay Pots , and in Planter Boxes (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) will drop Seeds. Flowers typically drop 4 Seeds at a time, while tall grass typically drops 1–2 Seeds.

The Blend-O-Matic is a crafting station that is purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC . On the Old-gen console and 3DS , it can only be purchased at night. Its sole purpose is to craft Asphalt Blocks which are used to run faster when walked on.

The Confetti Gun is a consumable novelty weapon that fires a cloud of colorful confetti. This effect is purely visual and causes no damage or functional effect. Confetti Guns are consumed upon use; they can only be used once each. They are purchased from the Party Girl for 1 SC each.
The Dye Vat is a crafting station used to craft dyes , paints , and colored string and Golf Balls . It is purchased from the Dye Trader for 5 GC .

The Bunny Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture / weapon . It can be purchased from the Pirate for 50 GC when the Party Girl is present and one of the mechanical bosses has been defeated. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed). The Bunny Cannon fires an arcing Explosive Bunny projectile that does not destroy blocks and pierces an infinite amount of targets. After the projectile loses all its momentum, it will (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) transform into an Explosive Bunny critter / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) explode after several seconds.

Cogs are Hardmode crafting materials and placeable blocks that are purchased from the Steampunker for 7 SC each. They are used to make High Velocity Bullets , Liquid Sensors , and Steampunk furniture .
Confetti is a crafting material used to make several festive items. It is also used as ammunition for the Confetti Cannon . It is purchased from the Party Girl for 2 SC each.

Explosive Powder is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Demolitionist for 12 SC each, once the Wall of Flesh has been defeated. It is solely used to make Exploding Bullets , an ammo type with strong knockback .
The Beanie is a vanity item purchased from the Clothier for 1 GC , while living in the Snow biome .

Empty Bullets are a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Arms Dealer for 5 CC (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) / 3 CC (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) each. While they have no function as ammunition on their own, Empty Bullets are used to craft Hardmode bullets with special effects.

The Bubble Machine is a novelty furniture mechanism purchased from the Party Girl for 4 GC (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) during the day / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) at any time. When placed, it continuously produces bubbles. These bubbles are purely visual, have no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost.

The Bubble Wand is an auto-swing novelty item that produces rainbow-colored bubbles. The bubbles are purely visual, have no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost. The Bubble Wand is purchased from the Party Girl for 5 GC .
The Autohammer is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Shroomite Bars as well as Mini Nuke I and II . It can be purchased from the Truffle for 1 PC after Plantera has been defeated.
The Christmas Tree is a decorative Hardmode furniture item purchased from Santa Claus for 25 SC . It can be decorated with toppers, garlands, bulbs, and lights to alter its appearance.
The Angel Halo is a vanity accessory purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 40 GC .
The Fez is a head piece vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 3 GC 50 SC .
The Bug Net can be purchased from the Merchant for (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 25 SC / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 1 GC .

Crimson Seeds are seeds used to plant Crimson grass on Dirt Blocks , which will then spread The Crimson in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for 5 SC each during a Blood Moon in a world with Crimson. In a world with Corruption , Crimson Seeds can be purchased from the Dryad if she is spoken to in a Hardmode Graveyard .
The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode .

The Flesh Cloning Vat is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Flesh furniture ( Crimson -themed furniture) out of Flesh Blocks . The Flesh Cloning Vat can be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC , but only appears for sale in worlds that are generated with the Crimson . It can also be crafted from the Decay Chamber , its Corruption counterpart.
The Brick Layer is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC . While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing blocks .

The Extendo Grip is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC . While equipped, it increases placement range and tool range by 2 tiles vertically and 3 tiles horizontally.
The Fancy Dishes are a furniture item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 20 SC .
Dynasty Wood is a type of wood purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 CC per block. When placed, it forms continuous structures with automatic frames.

The Gatligator is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 35 GC . When used, it rapidly fires bullets in a roughly 30° spread, at a varying velocity. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammo .
The Diamond Ring is a vanity accessory . When worn, it places a blue dot on each of the player's wrists. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 PC .

The Gi is an armor item that can be equipped in the shirt slot. It provides 4 defense along with a 5% damage and critical strike chance boost to weapons. It also provides a 10% melee and movement speed increase. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC . The Gi will visually cover up what is equipped in the pants slot.

The Fireworks Box is a placed novelty mechanism that launches colorful visual effects. Once placed, it can be activated via wire or by right-clicking the Box directly. Each activation causes the Box to fire a random one of four possible fireworks effects that cause no damage. It can be used infinitely at no cost. The Fireworks Box is purchased from the Party Girl for 5 GC .

The Firework Fountain is a placed novelty mechanism that, when activated, produces one of four colorful "sparkle fountain" effects. Once placed, the Fountain can be activated via wire , or by right-clicking the Fountain directly. Its effect is purely visual, causes no damage, and can be used infinitely at no cost. It is purchased from the Party Girl for 3 GC .

Booster Tracks are placeable furniture -type blocks that can be placed next to Minecart Tracks to automatically boost the speed of a Minecart that rides over it. The direction of the boost is indicated by the animated red arrow it displays, which can be toggled using a Hammer or wire . Each Booster Track increases speed by 20 mph , regardless of the Minecart variant used. The Booster Track can be purchased from the Mechanic for 50 SC .
The Bone Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 15 CC each, during moon phases 1 (full), 2, 5 (new), and 6. Bone Arrows can pierce one enemy .

The Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage is an accessory that, when equipped, allows the player to collect Vine Ropes when destroying vines . The Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being found inside surface Chests , or a 1/100 (1%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing . It can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC during First Quarter moons.
The DPS Meter can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC .

The Empty Dropper is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Wizard for 1 SC . It is used in the crafting of Magic Droppers . The Crystal Ball must be near water , lava , or honey , to craft the respective liquid's dropper.
Bubbles are purchased from the Party Girl for 2 SC each during Hardmode .
The Code 1 is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC once the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated.
The Code 2 is a Hardmode , post one- mechanical boss yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 25 GC .
The Format:C is a Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 20 GC during moon phases 5–8.

The Confetti Cannon is a Hardmode novelty furniture / mechanism . It is purchased from the Party Girl for 25 GC , when the Pirate is present. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack key on it with Confetti in hand, by pressing the Auto Select key with Confetti in the player's inventory, or tapping the Confetti Cannon with Confetti in hand.
The Copper Axe can also be purchased from the Merchant for 4 SC .

The Copper Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe . It can mine blocks weaker than Meteorite . Newly created characters spawn with a Copper Pickaxe ( Iron Pickaxe in Journey Mode ). It can also be purchased from the Merchant for 5 SC .

The Celebration is a Hardmode , post- Golem launcher that fires two firework rocket projectiles at once, consuming one rocket . The firework rockets travel for 0.75 seconds before exploding. The Celebration can be purchased from the Party Girl for 80 GC .

The Presserator is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC . It automatically places Actuators to objects when placing them. It requires Actuators to be in the player's inventory in order to function.
The Engineering Helmet is a vanity item equipped on the Social Helmet Slot . It is purchased from the Mechanic for 1 GC .
The Companion Cube is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Companion Cube that follows the player. The Companion Cube can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 PC .
The Defender's Forge is a portable, personal storage item which is purchased from the Tavernkeep for 500000* 50 .

The Eternia Crystal Stand is a furniture item that initiates the Old One's Army event when an Eternia Crystal is placed on it with ⚷ Open / Activate . The Eternia Crystal Stand can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for 1 GC .

The Eternia Crystal is an event-summoning item. When used on the Eternia Crystal Stand while under the correct terrain requirements , the Old One's Army event begins. The Eternia Crystal can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for 25 SC (pre-one mechanical boss ), 1 GC (post-one mechanical boss), or 4 GC (post- Golem ).

The Drum Set is a novelty furniture item used in conjunction with the Drumstick to produce drum sounds. The Drum Set and Drumstick can be purchased from the Merchant for 10 GC and 50 SC respectively after either the Eater of Worlds , the Brain of Cthulhu , Skeletron , or the Wall of Flesh has been defeated.
The Anti-Portal Block is a Hardmode block that prevents portals from the Portal Gun or Portal Gun Station to form on it. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 SC .

The Celestial Wand is a pet-summoning item that spawns Estee to follow the player. When the player is far enough away, Estee will emit a bright yellow beam trail while flying at high speed in order to catch up to them, which resembles that of a Fallen Star . The Celestial Wand can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 PC , and is always sold alongside the Star Princess set .
It can be purchased from the Cyborg for 7 SC 50 CC each after completing the Martian Madness event.
Cluster Rocket IIs can be purchased from the Cyborg for 15 SC each during a Blood Moon or Solar Eclipse after the Martian Madness event has been defeated.
The Demon Horns are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Bamboo Leaf is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Red Panda to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Red Panda will fly towards them while surfing on a bamboo leaf to catch up to them. The Bamboo Leaf can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 75 GC .

The Fog Machine is a placed novelty mechanism that produces a fog cloud around it. It can be activated and deactivated via wire , but is always on by default when first placed. The fog is purely visual, has no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost. When Fog Machines are placed next to each other and are active, the fog gets thicker which makes it harder to see through. The Fog Machine is purchased from the Party Girl for 4 GC at night.
The Devil Horns are a vanity item that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .
The Fedora is a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Exotic Chew Toy is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Fennec Fox that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Fennec Fox pet will fly by flapping its ears like wings to catch up to them. The Exotic Chew Toy can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 PC .

Critter Shampoo is a vanity accessory equipped in a social accessory slot that changes the color of summoned minions when paired with a dye in the corresponding dye slot. It is purchased from the Zoologist for 10 GC after completing at least 30% (164 entries) of the Bestiary .

The Guide to Critter Companionship is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from harming critters while inside their inventory or opened Void Bag . It can be purchased from the Zoologist for 5 GC .
Bernie's Button is a Hardmode , post- Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns Bernie to follow the player. Bernie's Button can be purchased from the Princess for 25 GC .

Ash Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Ash grass . They are purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC 50 CC each, when she is talked to in The Underworld . They can also be gathered by clearing Ash grass foliage in the Underworld. Ash trees can grow on planted Ash grass.
The Guide to Environmental Preservation is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents the player's attacks from breaking plants while inside their inventory . It can be purchased from the Dryad for 5 GC .

The Artisan Loaf is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the range that the player can access crafting stations by 4 tiles in all directions. The Artisan Loaf can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 10 GC during a Waning Crescent , New Moon , or Waxing Crescent . It can also only be used once per player, and the Skeleton Merchant will cease to sell it once the player has consumed an Artisan Loaf.

The Killing Deck is a Hardmode magic weapon that can be purchased from the Wizard for 20 GC during a Blood Moon . When used, three waves of cards are launched. The first launch consists of a single card, the second of two cards launched in opposite directions, and the third of a spread of six cards. These cards fly for 0.5 seconds in a serpentine pattern before abruptly falling. They stick to any block or enemy they hit, but stop dealing damage after becoming stuck. The cards return to the player upon using the weapon for the fourth time, or after being stuck to a block or enemy for more than 5 seconds. While returning, the cards deal 150% of the weapon's damage (33 base damage) and pierce infinitely. [ 1 ]
The Swarm Grenade is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Swarm Biter that follows the player. The Swarm Grenade can be purchased from the Zoologist for 10 GC during a Party .
Easter Blocks are pre-Hardmode blocks purchased from the Dye Trader for 50 CC each. Their main use is crafting Easter furniture and Easter Walls .
The Shotgun is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 25 GC . When used, it fires a spread of 4–5 bullets , consuming one piece of ammunition .
The Tam O' Shanter is a Hardmode vanity item purchased from the Clothier for 2 GC 50 SC , during the third quarter moon phase .

The Ice Machine is a crafting station used to craft Frozen furniture out of Ice Blocks and Snow furniture out of Snow Blocks . The Ice Machine has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Frozen Chests in the Ice biome . On Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , it can also be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC while in the Snow biome .
The Katana is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC . It has a base 19% critical strike chance , as opposed to the usual 4%.

The Mechanical Lens is an informational accessory which will reveal placed wires and actuators . Each color of wire can be shown at maximum brightness, regular, or faded, which is configurable by the toggles . The Mechanical Lens is purchased from the Mechanic for 1 GC .
The Shuriken is a consumable ranged weapon . It can hit up to 4 targets. Shurikens can be found in Pots and Chests around the world, and can be purchased from the Merchant for 15 CC each.

The Minishark is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 35 GC . When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a slight spread, with each shot having a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of not consuming any ammunition .
The Switch is an activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for 20 SC . It can also be found in the Dungeon connected to Chain Lanterns , where it can be harvested with a Pickaxe or Drill .

The Hammush is a Hardmode , post-one mechanical boss hammer that is purchased from the Truffle for 40 GC . When swung, the Hammush releases mushroom projectiles at its tip. Like the Pwnhammer , it can destroy altars .

The Wire Bulb is a light source that has multiple colors. It is purchased from the Mechanic for 5 GC . Each corner can be lit up by wires . Each color of wire lights up a different corner. As there are four wire colors, there are four corners with four separate colors. The Wire Bulb can be placed in midair, without the need for support.

The Portal Gun Station is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord furniture item and mechanism that can fire portals, similar to the Portal Gun . The Portal Gun Station can be purchased from the Cyborg for 10 GC if the player has a Portal Gun or another Portal Gun Station in their inventory .
The Bunny License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for 5 GC after filling out 45% (246 entries) of the Bestiary .

The FPV Goggles are a Hardmode , post- Plantera accessory purchased from the Cyborg for 10 GC . It centers the screen on the Kwad Racer Drone or Wall Racer Car while one is active, allowing the player to fly the drone or drive the car without having to keep it within the screen, or to use it to scout out areas that are difficult to reach.

The Lihzahrd Furnace is a Hardmode , post- Plantera crafting station used to craft Lihzahrd furniture out of Lihzahrd Bricks . It is always found in every Lihzahrd Chest in the Jungle Temple . Once Golem has been defeated, it can also be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC when she is spoken to in the Jungle .

Pho is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff . This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon ( ) , by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff ( ) , or by double-tapping the buff icon ( ) . Pho can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 75 SC .

The Spelunker Glowstick is a consumable light source that can be held or tossed a fair distance, similar to the regular Glowstick . In addition, it highlights the location of nearby treasures in a 30-tile radius around the glowstick with a slight yellowish glimmer. Spelunker Glowsticks can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 1 SC 50 CC each at nighttime . During a full moon , they can also be purchased at daytime.

Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant regular grass on Dirt Blocks . They are purchased from the Dryad for 20 CC each, while a Blood Moon is not occurring. They can also be obtained from putting Poo into an Extractinator .
The Orange Zapinator is a Hardmode magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 GC . Meteor armor 's set bonus will reduce its mana cost to 0.
The Ruler is a pre-Hardmode shortsword purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 SC . It swings four times in quick succession per use, with slightly varying angles with each stab.
The Pygmy Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that provides the player with one additional minion slot . It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 GC at night .
The Imbuing Station is a crafting station used to craft flasks . It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 7 GC .
The Kimono is a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 GC .

The Mollusk Whistle is a mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Flamingo . The Flamingo mount allows players to float in water , similar to using an Inner Tube , and dive by holding ▼ Down . The mount bobs to the surface when the ▼ Down key is released, and if deep enough, the player will launch out of the water into the air. The Mollusk Whistle can be purchased from the Zoologist for 20 GC after filling out 25% (137 entries) of the Bestiary .
The Dog License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for 5 GC after filling out 25% (137 entries) of the Bestiary .

The Smoke Bomb is a throwable, consumable novelty item that, when thrown, emits thick gray smoke for one minute. Upon throwing a Smoke Bomb, it will bounce or roll until it comes to a complete stop and continues to release smoke. Each can only be used once and cannot be picked up again once thrown. Smoke Bombs can be purchased from the Party Girl for 20 CC each.

The Paint Sprayer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC . While equipped, or (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) when held in the inventory , it automatically applies paint or coating to any object when placing it. Like the Paintbrush and the Paint Roller , it will use the paint that is first in order in the inventory.

The Mechanical Ruler is an informational accessory that, when equipped, draws a cyan, semi-transparent grid overlay on the screen, making individual block distances much clearer. This grid fades out when the player begins moving and returns once movement stops. The row and column of the block the mouse is hovering over are also highlighted in red, drawing a cross on the screen with the cursor at its center. The Mechanical Ruler can be purchased from the Mechanic for 1 GC .

The Slap Hand is a Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 25 GC during a Blood Moon . It is notable for having extremely high base knockback – a rating of 20, one of the highest values among all player-caused sources of knockback. The Slap Hand also has a 19% base critical strike chance , as opposed to the usual 4%.

The Kwad Racer Drone is a Hardmode , post- Plantera novelty item purchased from the Cyborg for 10 GC . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button while selected in the hotbar summons a harmless drone that can be controlled by the ▲ Up , ◀ Left , and ▶ Right buttons. Pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again or switching to another item instantly destroys the drone. The player appears to wield a remote control when the drone is in use.

The Sunflower is a large, tall plant which can be found growing naturally on grass , and can be broken with a pickaxe or drill , or by coming into contact with water . It cannot be grown from seeds like most other plants, but is instead placed fully-grown, either naturally upon world generation or by the player. It can also be purchased from the Dryad for 50 SC each, while a Blood Moon is not occurring.
Hellfire Arrows can be found in Shadow Chests and Pots in The Underworld , crafted at an anvil , or purchased from the Demolitionist for 1 SC each in Hardmode .

Gold Dust is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Merchant for 17 SC each. Its sole purpose is to craft the Flask of Gold and Golden Bullets , which both allow the player to inflict the Midas debuff .

The Water Gun can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 GC 50 SC and also has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to be dropped by Jungle Mimics (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , which spawn in Celebration Mk 10 (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Zenith (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) worlds.

The Mystic Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It provides minimal defense (2) but a 6% damage and critical strike boost to magic weapons , along with a 10% reduction in mana use. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 3 GC 50 SC .
The Gradient is a Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 20 GC during moon phases 1–4.

The Yoyo Glove is a Hardmode accessory that is purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 50 GC . While equipped, hitting an enemy with a yoyo will create a duplicate of that yoyo that rapidly orbits around the main one.
Vulkelf Ears are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Safe is a portable storage item with 40 slots to store other items. The Safe, Piggy Bank , Defender's Forge (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , and Void Vault (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) have the unique ability to be carried while they contain items. The Safe can be purchased from the Merchant for 20 GC after Skeletron has been defeated.
The Star Hairpin is a vanity item that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC . It is worn in the helmet slot.

The Yellow Willow Sapling is a type of seed that grows into a Yellow Willow tree , which is a tree that can also spawn naturally in Forest biomes , when planted. Its appearance is purely decorative and it functions identically to regular forest trees. Yellow Willow Saplings can be purchased from the Zoologist for 1 GC once the Bestiary is 30% completed (164 entries).
The Lever is a 2×2 activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for 30 SC . It can activate Statues , lights, etc. via ⚷ Open / Activate .
The Paintbrush is a tool which is used to apply paint to tiles. It is purchased from the Painter for 1 GC . Its upgrade, the Spectre Paintbrush , grants a bonus to range.

The Parrot Cracker is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Parrot that follows the player. If the player stays still for long enough, it will perch on a nearby solid block, staying still until the player moves away from it. The Parrot Cracker can be purchased from the Pirate for 3 PC 75 GC if he is spoken to in an Ocean biome.

The Strange Glowing Mushroom is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Truffle that follows the player. The Baby Truffle emits a small amount of blue light similar to Glowing Mushrooms . The Strange Glowing Mushroom can be purchased from the Truffle for 45 GC .
Bundled Party Balloons are a vanity accessory purchased from the Clothier for 2 GC while a Party is active. When worn, the balloons will be shown being held by the player, bobbing up and down.

The Plasma Lamp is a mechanism item that emits a faint blue light and has an animated texture. It is not considered a suitable light source for an NPC house . It is used purely as a decorative light source. The Plasma Lamp can be purchased from the Party Girl for 2 GC .

The Spiky Ball is a consumable ranged weapon that is primarily used as a passive trap by tossing them to the ground, where enemies who pass over them will take damage up to 7 times (after which the Spiky Balls vanish). If not destroyed, they will automatically vanish after 1 minute and 20 seconds. [ 1 ] They can also be directly thrown at enemies, but they have a very short arc and quickly fall to the ground. Spiky Balls have a 199/400 (49.75%) chance of being dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event (except for the Goblin Warlock ), and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each.

The Magic String is a Hardmode , post-one mechanical boss accessory that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 1 PC . While equipped, all yoyos and Counterweights are thrown when ⚒ Use / Attack is released, instead of being retracted. The released projectiles deal 75% of their initial damage and knockback, and can bounce and roll on blocks and platforms . [ 1 ]
The Spell Tome is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Wizard for 5 GC .

The Mushroom Spear is a Hardmode , post-one mechanical boss spear that can be purchased from the Truffle for 70 GC . When thrust, it summons seven spinning mushrooms that linger in midair and deal 33.33% of the weapon's damage (20 base damage) but do not inflict knockback . [ 1 ]

The Land Mine is a unique Hardmode , post- Plantera placeable item. They remain dormant once placed, until a character touches them or they are activated by Wire , at which point they explode, dealing 250 damage. They are purchased from the Demolitionist for 5 GC each, after Plantera and at least one Pirate Invasion have been defeated.

The Honey Dispenser is a crafting station used to craft Honey furniture out of Honey Blocks . The Honey Dispenser has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Ivy Chests in the Underground Jungle . On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , it can also be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC in the Jungle .

Pad Thai is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon ( ) , by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff ( ) , or by double-tapping the buff icon ( ) . Pad Thai can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 55 SC .

The HiTek Sunglasses are a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity item for the social helmet slot. They are similar to the Sunglasses and Goggles , in that they provide eye graphics without concealing the player's hair. HiTek Sunglasses are purchased from the Cyborg for 5 GC , after the Martian Madness event has been defeated.

The Pogo Stick is a mount-summoning item that summons a Pogo Stick Mount . Jumping again while in the air causes the player to do a front flip. The Pogo Stick Mount doubles the speed at which the player falls, and reduces fall damage by 60%. It has a max speed of 28 mph , and also has a certain amount of momentum while airborne, meaning it continues traveling in the last horizontal direction the player inputted while in the air, rather than slowing. The Pogo Stick can be purchased from the Party Girl for 25 GC .

Wooden Arrows can be crafted, found in Pots and Chests , dropped by Pincushion Zombies , and purchased from the Merchant for 5 CC each. They can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during moon phases 2, 3, 6, and 7.
The Jetpack can be purchased from the Steampunker for 40 GC during the following moon phases :

The Lightning Carrot is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Volt Bunny that follows the player. While flying to keep pace with the player, the Volt Bunny dashes and releases a series of spherical blue sparks, which emit a decent amount of light while moving erratically and can spread light over an area. If there are no available tiles for the pet to "sit" on, like when climbing walls or flying, the Volt Bunny will constantly jump around. The Lightning Carrot can be purchased from the Zoologist for 50 GC after completing 50% (273 entries) of the Bestiary .

The Moon Globe is a thrown consumable item purchased from the Zoologist for 3 GC after the Bestiary is 50% complete (273 entries). When a Moon Globe is thrown and shatters on a surface, the world's moon style will be randomized to one of 9 options.
The Goblorc Ears are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Wooden Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that can be found in Wooden Chests located on the surface and within the underground layer . It can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 1 GC during a full moon .

The Pulse Bow is a Hardmode bow that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 45 GC after defeating all three mechanical bosses . When used, it converts any type of arrow into a high-velocity blue bolt. The bolt is unaffected by gravity, can either pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to five times, and travels for 3.5 seconds (about 480 tiles) before dissipating. The Pulse Bow also has a base 11% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

The Sakura Sapling is a type of seed that grows into a Sakura tree , which is a tree that can also spawn naturally in Forest biomes , when planted. Its appearance is purely decorative and it functions identically to regular forest trees. Sakura Saplings can be purchased from the Zoologist for 1 GC once the Bestiary is 30% completed (164 entries).

The Hercules Beetle is a Hardmode , post- Plantera accessory that increases the damage of summon weapons by 15% and increases their knockback by 2. [ 1 ] The Hercules Beetle can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 40 GC if he is spoken to in the Jungle after Plantera has been defeated.

Nanites are a Hardmode crafting material used solely for crafting the Flask of Nanites and Nano Bullets , whose purpose is to inflict the Confused debuff with melee and ranged weapons , respectively. Nanites are purchased from the Cyborg for 15 SC each.

The Magic Lantern is a light pet-summoning item that spawns a small glowing Magic Lantern which hovers above the player, emitting dim yellow light. The lantern will also expose all treasure within up to 15 tiles from the lantern's location, overlaying small yellow sparkles over nearby valuable treasure, which is similar to the sparkling effect produced by a Spelunker Potion . The Magic Lantern can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 10 GC during the night of a full moon .

The Piggy Bank is a portable storage item which can be purchased from the Merchant for 1 GC . Like other storage items (eg. chests ), it contains 40 slots (4 rows of 10) that can be used to store anything. The Piggy Bank requires only a space 2 wide and 1 high for placement, but must be placed on a Work Bench , Table , or platforms (in contrast, the Safe , Defender's Forge (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , and Void Vault (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) can be placed on blocks , but are considerably larger). The Piggy Bank inventory can also be accessed via the Money Trough (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , which summons a temporary floating version of the Piggy Bank, or the Eye Bone (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) .
The Sickle is purchased from the Merchant for 60 SC .
The Balloon Animal is a vanity accessory purchased from the Clothier for 2 GC while a Party is active. When worn, the Balloon Animal will be shown being held by the player, bobbing up and down.

The Decay Chamber is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Lesion furniture ( Corruption -themed furniture) out of Lesion Blocks . The Decay Chamber can be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC but only appears for sale in worlds that are generated with the Corruption . It can also be crafted from the Flesh Cloning Vat , its Crimson counterpart.

Sake is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff when consumed, which increases many of the player's stats but lowers the player's defense for 4 minutes, twice the duration of Ale . Sake can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 SC .

The Pin Wheel is a novelty furniture . When placed, the wheel spins if it is windy , with its spin speed depending on the current wind speed in the area. It is purchased from the Merchant for 20 SC during the Windy Day event.

The Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon which can be purchased from the Demolitionist for 75 CC each, or found rarely in pots and natural Chests . Once Hardmode is activated, they can be found in Pots (replacing Shurikens ).
The Toolbelt is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 GC . While equipped, it grants +1 placement range , but not tool range.

The Tiki Totem is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Tiki Spirit that floats and spins above the player's head. Unlike most pets, it will not teleport to the player when the player moves too quickly for it to keep up; it will simply float straight towards the player. The Tiki Totem can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 2 PC when he is spoken to in the Jungle biome during Hardmode .
The Lawn Flamingo is a decorative furniture item that can be placed and serves no purpose other than as decoration. It can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC .
The Cat License is a consumable item that can be purchased from the Zoologist for 5 GC .

Rocket Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 5 GC . While equipped, they allow the player to hold ↷ Jump in midair to fly for a total of 1.17 seconds. [ 1 ] While flying, the boots emit visual flame particles that give off a large amount of light.

The Ice Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires blocks of ice, which have the unique ability of placing solid, temporary Ice Blocks at the location of the cursor and which last for 15 seconds before shattering. These Ice Blocks are translucent, cast a dim, flickering blue light, and are slippery like normal Ice Blocks . The Ice Rod can be purchased from the Wizard for 50 GC .
The Vial of Venom is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Witch Doctor for 15 SC each, after Plantera has been defeated.

The Revolver is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 15 GC after a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart has been smashed. Firing the Revolver just as it comes off cooldown will gradually increase its attack speed (up to 100%) and critical strike chance (up to 20%). This effect will not be triggered if the player is autofiring the weapon.
The Stopwatch can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC .
The Mushroom Cap is a vanity hat purchased from the Truffle for 2 GC . It greatly resembles a Glowing Mushroom without the stalk.

The Paint Roller is a tool which is used to paint walls . It is purchased from the Painter for 1 GC . Its upgrade, the Spectre Paint Roller , grants a bonus to range. Using a roller requires paint to be in the player's inventory .

The Steampunk Boiler is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Steampunk furniture out of Cogs . The Steampunk Boiler can be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC , once the Eye of Cthulhu , Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu and Skeletron have been defeated.

The Night Vision Helmet is an armor piece for the helmet slot. For the player wearing it, it increases the apparent light level provided by all light sources on the screen, similarly to the Night Owl buff . The Night Vision Helmet has a 1/30 (3.33%) chance to be dropped by Granite Elementals and Granite Golems . It can also be purchased from the Cyborg for 5 GC , after the Martian Madness event has been completed in the current world.

The Tragic Umbrella is a pre-Hardmode shortsword and held item that can be purchased from the Clothier for 10 GC while in a Graveyard . It functions identical to the standard Umbrella , aside from dealing higher damage.

The Tinkerer's Workshop is a crafting station that is used primarily to combine multiple accessories into single items that usually provide the abilities of their components. For instance, it can combine the Rocket Boots and Hermes Boots into a single item (the Spectre Boots ) that provides the same rocket-jumping and accelerated movement as the individual items do, without occupying two accessory slots. The Tinkerer's Workshop can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 GC .

The Proximity Mine Launcher is a Hardmode , post- Plantera launcher that can be purchased from the Cyborg for 35 GC . When used, it consumes a rocket and fires a mine that travels in a short arc before becoming stationary and semi-transparent until an enemy approaches or until a minute passes, at which point it explodes. The player will not activate the mine, but will be damaged by an exploding mine. Stationary mines deal 300% of the weapon's damage (240 base damage) [ 1 ] to enemies, but not to players, who only take 100% damage instead.

Smoke Blocks are animated background furniture blocks that can be purchased from the Party Girl for 1 SC in Hardmode . When placed together, they will connect in a way that each block on the outer left and right sides visually take up half of a block. For example, if a player were to make a 3×3 arrangement of Smoke Blocks, the entire left and right columns of smoke will appear to be halved, resulting in a slimmer appearance.

The Lava Lamp is a furniture item purchased from the Party Girl for 2 GC , that emits a small amount of light and has an animated texture. It is not a mechanism but can be placed on tables . It is not considered a suitable light source for an NPC house . It is used purely as a decorative light source.

The Junction Box is a mechanism that allows wires of the same color to cross without connecting. It is purchased from the Mechanic for 2 SC . The Junction Box can be placed in midair, without the need for support. Hammering the Junction Box changes the directions that the different colored wires enter and exit the Junction Box.

The Sky Mill has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being obtained from Skyware Chests on Floating Islands . It can also be purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC if she is spoken to in Space (above 65% altitude of the surface).
The Portable Cement Mixer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC . While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing walls .

The Magic Hat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece that can be equipped in the helmet slot. While equipped, it grants +2 defense and increases the player's magic damage and magic critical strike chance by 6% each. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 3 GC .
Pumpkin Seeds are purchased from the Dryad for 2 SC 50 CC each.
The balloons are purely visual, with no functional effect, and can be produced infinitely at no cost. The Silly Balloon Machine is purchased from the Party Girl for 5 GC .
The Fake Unicorn Horn is a vanity accessory purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Wall Racer Car is a Hardmode , post- Plantera novelty item purchased from the Cyborg for 10 GC . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button while selected in the hotbar summons a harmless car that can be controlled by the ◀ Left , and ▶ Right buttons and the ↷ Jump to jump. If the jump is pressed while the car is mid-air, the car will switch modes to instead drive on any placed walls and be controlled by the left and right button to steer, up and down button to move forward or backwards, and the jump button to jump off the wall. Pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again or switching to another item instantly destroys the car. The player appears to wield a remote control when the car is in use.

The Lesser Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 50 mana when used and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It can be purchased from the Merchant for 1 SC each, and can also be found in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing .
The Summer Hat is a vanity item equipped in the Social Helmet Slot. It is purchased from the Clothier for 1 GC , when he is spoken to during the day outside of a Graveyard .

The Mud Bud is a Hardmode , post- Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns Plantero , a miniature version of Plantera, that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, Plantero flies towards them in a manner similar to Plantera's second form while emitting a trail of falling leaves that are affected by wind . The Mud Bud can be purchased from the Zoologist for 50 GC after defeating Plantera .

The Marshmallow is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. This lasts for 1 minute, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon ( ) , by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff ( ) , or by double-tapping the buff icon ( ) . Marshmallows can be purchased from the Merchant for 1 SC each when he is spoken to in a Snow biome .

The Static Hook is a Hardmode grappling hook that fires up to two hooks which can be launched simultaneously, reaching up to 37.5 tiles (the longest reach of any hook). The Static Hook can be purchased from the Steampunker for 50 GC .
Panda Ears are a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 GC 50 SC .

The Jousting Lance is a Hardmode melee weapon purchased from the Zoologist for 6 GC after filling out 30% (164 entries) of the Bestiary . When attacking using ⚒ Use / Attack , the lance will extend, and holding ⚒ Use / Attack will keep it extended at a fixed angle. The damage and knockback will increase depending on the player's movement speed , making mounts , sprinting accessories , or dash abilities (such as those granted by Shield of Cthulhu , Tabi / Master Ninja Gear , or Solar Flare armor ) useful for maximizing damage. When the player takes damage, the Jousting Lance will stop being active.
The Rabbit Perch is vanity item purchased from the Zoologist for 15 GC after filling out 40% (219 entries) of the Bestiary .

The Greater Mana Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 200 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. Unlike most potions, Greater Mana Potions cannot be crafted, and are instead purchased from the Wizard for 5 SC , or dropped from all Biome Mimics except the Jungle Mimic .
The Lifeform Analyzer can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC .

The Gray Zapinator is a pre-Hardmode -exclusive [ 1 ] magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 17 GC . It is only available once King Slime , the Eye of Cthulhu , Eater of Worlds , Brain of Cthulhu , Queen Bee , Deerclops , or Skeletron has been defeated. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Orange Zapinator .

The Acorn is a type of seed used to plant trees . Acorns can be planted on regular green grass , Hallowed grass , Corrupt grass , Crimson grass , Jungle grass , Sand , or Snow , where they will create saplings that will grow into trees, under the right conditions . Acorns are randomly dropped when cutting down or shaking trees and can also be purchased from the Dryad for 10 CC each.
Arcane Rune Wall is a background wall that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 SC 50 CC each. It is one of the few animated walls, as the runes displayed change every few seconds.

The Ball O' Fuse Wire is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Dynamite Kitten , which resembles the Orange Tabby variant of the Town Cat , that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Kitten will ride towards them on a stick of Dynamite and immediately dismount when it is on solid ground. The Ball O' Fuse Wire can be purchased from the Zoologist for 50 GC after completing 70% (383 entries) of the Bestiary .

The Birdie Rattle is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Lil' Harpy that follows the player. The Lil' Harpy, when summoned, will fly above and behind the player, and will behave similar to the Zephyr Fish , continually flying around and looking side to side. It will never land and can fly through blocks. The Birdie Rattle can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 GC .

The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is normally always available to be be purchased from the Zoologist for 10 GC (except in certain scenarios ). It has a 50% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:
The Blue Chicken Egg is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Blue Chicken that follows the player. The Blue Chicken Egg can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 25 GC .
The Dirt Rod is purchased from the Dryad for (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 5 GC / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 20 GC .
The Freeze Bomb can be purchased from the Demolitionist for 10 SC at night after the Eye of Cthulhu or King Slime has been defeated.
The Booster Track is purchased from the Mechanic for 50 SC .

Mushroom Grass Seeds are seeds that have a 1/40 (2.5%) chance to drop from harvesting Glowing Mushrooms . The seeds can also be purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC 50 CC each if she is spoken to in a Glowing Mushroom biome . Shaking a Giant Glowing Mushroom occasionally yields Mushroom Grass Seeds as well.
The Sail is a type of background wall purchased from the Pirate for 50 CC each. It is considered a valid wall for housing .

The Squirrel Hook can be purchased from the Zoologist for 2 GC after filling out at least 10% (55 entries) of the Bestiary . Therefore, it is normally always available for purchase, since the Zoologist does not appear before the Bestiary has been filled to at least 10%. The only exception is the secret world seed Vampirism , where she is the starting NPC .
